d: A razor-thin line slicing through the Saudi desert, walls of mirrored glass rising higher than the clouds, housing millions inside one continuous structure. It sounds like science fiction, but it was meant to be real. In 2016, Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman unveiled Vision 2030 — a trillion-dollar plan to reinvent Saudi Arabia beyond oil. From NEOM to The Line, Trojena, and The Cube, the ambition was unmatched. But today, those dreams are being scaled back. Four years from 2030, the question is no longer how big it gets — but how much survives.
